Before I approve it, I need to know: is there anything — any fact, any development, any concern — that should change this draft plan? I'd rather hear it now than after we've committed to a strategy in front of the judge.

transcript.text: Elena, there is a fact that should change the draft plan. I confirmed with the engineering security team this week that the proposed protective order is inadequate for our source code. It allows two named employees of the opposing party to access produced code, but our board-approved security policy requires source-code access to be limited to outside counsel and independent experts who have signed enhanced source-code acknowledgments. I had not yet updated the litigation plan because the security team's confirmation arrived after the last legal-team meeting.
